parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by extraction status. One of: processing, pending_review, confirmed, failed, rejected, duplicate_detected.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Filter extractions created on/after this date (Y-m-d).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Filter extractions created on/before this date (Y-m-d).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search across file_name, extracted vendor name, and invoice number.
